description_en: Cancels one or more simulated system events that are in the Scheduled or Executing state. After a system event is canceled, the simulated event enters the Canceled state
description_zh: 调用CancelSimulatedSystemEvents取消一件或多件处于Scheduled（计划中）或Executing（执行中）状态的模拟系统事件。取消系统事件后，模拟事件变为Canceled（已取消）状态
kebab_example: aliyun ecs cancel-simulated-system-events --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --event-id e-xhskHun12560000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelSimulatedSystemEvents

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of system event IDs. You can specify up to 100 event IDs
parameters.help_zh: 系统事件ID列表。可输入最多100个事件ID
parameters.name: event_id
